summary: All 31 task-04 Playwright tests passed in Chromium, including three new regressions for exact phrase boundaries, language-safe tidying with failure fallback, and unchanged third-language text in Quick Idea. No product bug was reproduced. The required git add -A && git commit attempt failed because the filesystem is read-only at .git/index.lock; it was not retried, so the new test file and this report remain uncommitted. Transcription responses were stubbed, so real Groq speech recognition was not verified.
